NOUGHTVAULT  //  MOTIF · THE UNIFICATION

One shape, two readings

The load-bearing idea in the whole textile programme. An inverted pucuk rebung under a circle is the keyhole in the NoughtVault mark — the border motif and the logo are the same triangle. The solid shaft is that triangle inset 9 mm, not a lookalike drawn to match. Nothing has to be explained and nothing has to be hidden, which is the only kind of concealment that survives being looked at.
